title.rendered: Building a Creative Agency: How and Why Creativate Was Started

content.rendered:
Great ideas spark businesses overnight, keeping you on your toes until they become a reality. And if there’s anyone who knows that feeling all too well, it’s us here at Creativate.

We say this with much excitement now, but if you had asked us about a year ago if starting a creative agency was in the cards, we would have likely said “no”. 

However, a moment of inspiration and accomplishment led us to create Creativate, and that is the reason why you are reading this blog on our website.

What inspired us?

The short answer: A passion project.  

The long (and honest) answer would be a project we took up out of curiosity to experiment with new ideas and escape the daily grind.

What started as a creative escape turned into a successful project for a thrilled client. That was our “Eureka!” moment. 

The perfect opportunity had presented itself before us, and we knew we had to seize it. 

The rest, as they say, is history. As clichéd as it sounds, no better phrase describes our journey.

We let our creative and marketing brain cells take the wheel, and that’s how our full-fledged creative agency, Creativate, was born (and yes, the name is a portmanteau of “Creativity” and “Innovate” – brownie points if you guessed that!). 

It is true that once the creative bug bites you, there is no turning back. We spent months developing this idea, laying the groundwork for a creative agency that would make a genuine impact.

Our mantra was simple: “Craft innovative solutions that deliver tangible results and become collaborative partners in your brand’s journey”.

So, who are we?

Creativate is a collective of marketing mavens obsessed with design, branding, social media, and more. We wield creativity and innovation like superpowers, transforming your design and marketing dreams into reality. 

And, when we are not in client meetings discussing strategies, you will find us out and about, exploring the latest trends to up our game so that we can help your brand stay ahead of the competition.

Here’s how we help you connect with your audience:

  • Logo Design & Branding: Craft a show-stopping brand identity that makes everyone take a double take.
  • UI/UX Design & Web Development:  Build a website so smooth and user-friendly that it makes people say, “Smooth like butter…!”
  • Social Media Handling: Curate compelling content that keeps your audience engaged and coming back for more.

That’s just the tip of the iceberg!  We offer all this and a comprehensive suite of creative agency services. 

We deliver what we promise and execute it flawlessly to achieve your marketing goals.

(You can check out our previous works here to get a glimpse of what we do and how we do it.)

And, if you have reached here and are curious to see what we can do for you, book a free consultation today and see how Creativate can help your brand take flight!
